reviewMethod: The two previously deferred stored SVG files for the currently selected Organic Letters paper were independently re-hashed from the frozen GitHub evidence archive and visually inspected against their owning captions and paper theme. Task/page/article DOI binding, original scheme identity, capture protocol 6.2.20, fixed media generation, direct ACS Silverchair source paths, role, clarity, duplicate/same-ID risk, and exact byte lengths were checked. Both SVGs are self-contained and contain no script, foreignObject, javascript URL, external http href, or event-handler content. The final report chain identifies the same DOI and records a successful 3/3 figure capture after earlier transport attempts; only the exact frozen direct-CDN bytes are approved. Capture success and storage review markers were treated as provenance evidence rather than semantic approval. Scheme 1 was already reviewed in an earlier batch and is not duplicated here. No publisher recrawl, R2 write, server-side direct import/repair, literature-data change, userscript change, or production deployment is authorized by this packet.
